About the room

A hotel restaurant built around a view

Waterside sits inside Hyatt Salt Lake with glass on every side and the garden pulled right up to the tables. It's a buffet in the traditional sense — long counters, real variety, food that's still being cooked when you get there — set inside a room that doesn't feel like a hotel restaurant at all.

Diners keep coming back for the range of it: a proper Indian spread alongside Chinese and continental counters, a dessert section that gets its own mentions, and service that, on a good night, matches the setting.

In their words

Reviewed for the view as much as the food

★★★★★

Waterside is set inside Hyatt Salt Lake and runs one of the largest buffet spreads around, with live counters throughout. Diners describe the food and service as excellent.

Google review
★★★★☆

The space itself draws consistent praise — spacious, bright, and calm — even on nights when the kitchen and the floor staff are working through a full room.

Google review
★★★★★

A regular pick for spending time with friends over a long lunch: good food, a genuinely nice atmosphere, and enough space to linger.

Google review

Diners consistently point to the extensive lunch buffet — Indian, Chinese and continental, with a strong dessert section — plus the atmosphere and spacious, friendly setting. Some reviews note that service can slow down at peak hours.
